# AxVisor RT-Thread Progress Report (2026-08-14)

## Major Breakthroughs

### 1. Dual VM Boot Success
- Linux VM (passthrough, CPU 0) + RT-Thread VM (routed_passthrough, CPU 2) boot simultaneously
- Using d7d273c2f commit's old config format (GPPT GIC emulation + passthrough IRQ)
- RT-Thread 5.2.2 boots to shell
- Linux 6.18.0-rc6 boots to userspace

### 2. Network Communication Established
- ICMP ping: 192.168.77.11 -> 192.168.77.30, 0% loss, 9.318ms RTT (first connection)
- RT-Thread virtio-net init successful (init_handler returned 0)

### 3. Key Fixes Applied
- VIRTIO_MMIO_BASE: 0x0b000000 -> 0x0a000400 (match passthrough bus 2)
- virtio vendor_id check relaxed: accept QEMU's 0x554d4551
- Build info file updated with vm_configs paths
- Legacy virtio-mmio registers (0x028/0x03c/0x040) no-op handlers

## Remaining Issues

### RT-IPC UDP Server Not Starting
- Server code compiled into binary (strings verified)
- INIT_APP_EXPORT should run before main()
- No "server starting" output visible (may be masked by Linux output)
- Linux client reports FAILED to connect

### New Config Format Stage-2 Issues
- guest_type=passthrough in new config system has Stage-2 translation faults
- Virtual device MMIO regions outside passthrough window not mapped
- Workaround: use d7d273c2f worktree with old config format
